title: Concept: Password field rendered with a value
description: An input of type password that already carries a value in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: A prefilled password sits in the HTML of a shared or cached page, and it also defeats the browser's own handling of stored credentials.
applicability: Deployments that render an input of type password that already carries a value into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: A prefilled password sits in the HTML of a shared or cached page, and it also defeats the browser's own handling of stored credentials.
